## Decision

The legacy JSONL store is the authoritative source until reconciliation completes. It holds 3248 of 3249 events. Any reconciliation reads from it and writes forward; nothing deletes or rewrites a shard.

## Rationale

The markdown store holds 0 decision files across all 27 motive directories; treating it as authoritative would erase all history. Dual-writing from now on without reconciling history was rejected as a standalone answer, though it is a component of the write-path fix.

## Alternatives Considered

- Treat the markdown store as authoritative — rejected, it is empty
- Dual-write without reconciling history — rejected as standalone answer
